name: Sync Valhalla Sigma rules into Sekoia Rules Catalog
description: Periodically pulls the Valhalla Sigma feed and POSTs each rule to the Sekoia Rules Catalog so it executes in the detection engine. POST on first seen, PUT on subsequent pulls. The server's current `enabled` flag is re-sent on PUT so a rule the user disabled in the catalog stays disabled across syncs.

enabled.title: Enable rules on push
enabled.description: When false (default), newly-created rules land in the catalog disabled — users opt in per rule. Only applied on initial POST; existing rules preserve whatever the user chose in the catalog.

min_sigma_level.title: Minimum Sigma level
min_sigma_level.description: Only rules with a Sigma `level` at least this severe are imported. Rules missing the `level` field are always skipped.

min_sigma_status.title: Minimum Sigma status
min_sigma_status.description: Only rules with a Sigma `status` at least this mature are imported (ordering: experimental < test < stable). Rules with status `deprecated` or `unsupported` are never imported. Rules missing the `status` field are always skipped.

disable_removed.title: Disable rules removed from the Valhalla feed
disable_removed.description: When Nextron removes a rule from the Valhalla feed (deprecated, superseded, withdrawn) — or when a rule newly drops below your configured minimum level/status — the sync disables it in the Sekoia catalog by setting enabled=false. The rule is NOT deleted: it stays in the catalog so you can inspect it, and if Nextron re-publishes it later the sync resumes updating in place. Default false — dry-run that only counts how many rules WOULD be disabled (see the `to_disable` field on the summary event). Set to true to actually disable.

preserve_rule_names.title: Preserve rule names (per-rule opt-out)
preserve_rule_names.description: Rules whose exact name appears in this list are NOT overwritten with Valhalla's content on subsequent syncs. Use it to protect hand-tuned rules: copy the rule's name from the Sekoia Rules Catalog UI into this list, and future syncs will skip the PUT for that rule (counted under `preserved` on the summary event). Match is exact and case-sensitive; surrounding whitespace is tolerated. Leave empty (default) to disable the per-rule check. The `disable_removed` pass still runs on preserved rules — it only flips `enabled` and keeps hand-edited content intact. Use the Form input mode; the Variable mode is not needed for this argument. If you want to delete entries from this list, we recommend creating a new trigger configuration.
